preconditions.description: The number of chairs n must be between 2 and 5000.

preconditions.expression: 1 <= s <= n and 1 <= e <= n and s != e
preconditions.description: Scott's starting position s and Cross's ending position e must be valid chair numbers, and they must be different.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= xi < xj <= 10**9 for xi, xj in zip(x, x[1:]))
preconditions.description: The coordinates of the chairs must be strictly increasing and within the range [1, 10^9].

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= ai <= 10**9 for ai in a)
preconditions.description: All landing times for large size must be positive integers within the range [1, 10^9].

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= bi <= 10**9 for bi in b)
preconditions.description: All landing times for small size must be positive integers within the range [1, 10^9].

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= ci <= 10**9 for ci in c)
preconditions.description: All jumping off times for small size must be positive integers within the range [1, 10^9].

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= di <= 10**9 for di in d)
preconditions.description: All jumping off times for large size must be positive integers within the range [1, 10^9].

postconditions.description: The output must be the minimum time Scott needs to reach Cross while visiting each chair exactly once.
